title: course fields
description: A course taken in a term. Open.

term_id.description: id of the term Item the course is taken in.

schedule_slots.description: Weekly timetable slots; empty when the course has no fixed time.

default_cloud_policy.description: Policy a new Attachment linked to this course resolves to when it has no explicit one; absent, the global default applies (D8, A6).

confirm_each_send.description: Ask before every cloud AI send for this course's material (D8).
